The '''Varlinaar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varlinaar]].
